description: Asian Paints (Lanka) Limited v. Director General of Customs and Excise and Another Asian Paints (Lanka) Limited v. Director General of Customs and Excise and Another View More before Hon. S. Sriskandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: Asian Paints (Lanka) Limited v. Director General of Customs and Excise and Another Asian Paints (Lanka) Limited v. Director General of Customs and Excise and Another View More
keywords: The Petitioner challenged the decision of the 1st Respondent demanding computation of excise duty on VAT inclusive of wholesale price in terms of Section 5(1)(a) of the Value Added Tax Act No 14 of 2002; preliminary objection on maintainability without paying due excise duty in terms of Section 10(1); Section 7(1) of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. Held - Preliminary objection overruled; ‘normal price’ is the price of the article sold to a buyer excluding VAT. Appeal allowed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Excise Duty (Special Provisions) Act No 13 of 1989
